title: Collared jackets & overshirts
summary: Brown and navy · Men’s S or M · Black Friday deals and everyday prices
evidenceNote: Maker leads: Derek Guy’s French chore coat guide and r/ThrowingFits and r/HeritageWear owner comments. Prices and fabric details come from retailers, not editorial sources.
caveat: Time Catcher’s Navy / S was $58.50 in cart with 26BFCM10. Prices exclude shipping and tax. END.’s corduroy jacket is a near match: lining and fill unconfirmed.

products.materialCaveat: END. identifies the corduroy fabric. Neither END. nor the maker specifies a lining or insulation material, or states that either is absent.
products.imageNote: All 5 photos from the retailer’s exact-color product gallery, in source order.
products.attribution: END. supplies the offer and photos. Maker’s Bark specification: https://serviceworks.xyz/products/fine-cord-work-jacket-bark . An indexed owner comment about a different Service Works coat is a style lead only, not evidence of this jacket’s lining or warmth: https://www.reddit.com/r/ThrowingFits/comments/19163ix/chore_coat_recommendations/

facts.Fit: Maker’s pit-to-pit measurements: S 22 in; M 23 in.
facts.Status: Candidate near match — NOT verified lining. S and M in stock at END.; link is color-specific, not size-specific.
